During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a sixteen [[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old '''female''' served at [[Alliance Base 16]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gaulus/Legends|Gaulus]] with her [[Unidentified Alliance officer (Gaulus)|mother]]. After the base was razed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, she was one of the only survivors and attempted to set the base's [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] to explode. She was interrupted by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Harles]] of [[Garrison Company 125a]], who allowed her to finish the job. She escaped with Harles and her badly wounded mother.
